storyCards.headline: The Hills: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Weeknd's "The Hills" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 48 weeks on the chart.

The Hills was released in 2015.

Album: Beauty Behind The Madness (2015).

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
